=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611 -- after s543b's `local TERM, TAIL` change) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- the three EXPRESSION rows as filed (silent): `$v = delete local $h{d}` in a sub -> perl dl=kept/kept PCL kept/undef ; the
  `our` hash -> kept/undef ; at file level perl top=kept/kept PCL top=/undef (the value lost too).  The STATEMENT form `{ delete local

LABEL: silent (already in the subject).


=== DONE (s543j, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22; WIP 1 dee665db) ===
A `delete local ELEM` that is a TERM of an expression, or a valued block's last statement, is the #3370 hoist with the value kept: `local ELEM = ELEM;` before the statement (the restore = the enclosing block's end) and the term left as `delete ELEM` (value = the old element(s)).  Only the VOID statement keeps the element open (Parser2::_local_term_reached).  `my (...) = delete local ...` hoists too (_decl_list_comma); a declined one in a statement the local machinery owns keeps that lowering.  Probes the s543j worktree (agent-abcd8b98eb856dbee) scratch/s543j/probes/m1 (25 shapes): base 7 = perl, tree 23 = perl; the 2 left are the #3370 refusal (LOUD, filed #5330: two delete locals in one expression; `1 + delete local`).  String eval (a17) = perl.  Guard Pl/t/local-elem-02.t M6 (inverse: fails on b58114ca).


=== REVIEW FIX (s543j, 2026-11-22 22:3x; WIP 9 276e9f55) -- the coordinator's finding 1 (rj/j-05) ===
A `delete local` inside a TERNARY ARM of a `my` declaration (`my $t = 1 ? delete local $h{b} : 0`) was neither hoisted nor refused: Pl::Stmt::is_local_stmt counts any top-level `delete local` in a `my` statement as the seam's, the miss loop left it there, and the seam lowered a plain delete (element gone for good).  Fix: Parser2::_delete_local_owned -- the old lowering is kept only where the `delete local` IS the statement's operand (the statement form, or directly after the declaration's `=`); deeper it is the #3370 refusal.  Positions (the s543j worktree (agent-abcd8b98eb856dbee) scratch/s543j/probes/m1r, 10 shapes, perl -> base -> tree): LOWERED = perl: a `do {}` block, a `my (LIST) = (delete local ..., X)` right side; REFUSED (LOUD, #5330): a ternary arm (in a declaration and as a void statement), an `&&` / `||` / `//` operand, a non-declaration list-assignment LHS (`($x, $y) = (...)`: the comma before the term), a hash-constructor value (`{ k => delete local ... }`: the `=>` before the term); the brace spelling `delete local ${h}{b}` (#5372's shape): the hoist declines its operand (a bareword inside the deref block reads as a call) and, being the declaration's direct operand, it keeps the seam's lowering -- silent as on main (base the same; #5372 note).  Guard Pl/t/local-term-01.t 8b (inverse ok).
